$comment: FPL rules as HARD constraints. Source: fpl-optimiser-spec.md Section 7 (2026/27 defaults).
Nothing here identifies a player, a club or a deadline - those always come from the live API.
Position keys are FPL element_type short codes (singular_name_short). At load time every key
here is reconciled against the element_types actually returned by bootstrap-static, so a
position rename or a new position fails loudly instead of being silently ignored.
All money is in tenths of a million (integers), matching the API's now_cost units.

sellingPrice.$comment: FPL splits profit: you bank half the rise, rounded down to the nearest 0.1m. Losses are passed on in full.

scoring.$comment: Only the parts the xPts model needs to reason about. Full scoring lives in the model config.

goalsConceded.$comment: -1 per N conceded, GK and DEF only

defensiveContribution.$comment: 2026/27 DefCon. DEF counts clearances+blocks+interceptions+tackles; MID/FWD add recoveries.
